struct.name: IIO_IGFX_1
struct.doc: Graphics node and widget register 1, the twin of iio_igfx_0 in the census. The header gives both the same field layout: widget number in bits 3:0, node number in bits 12:4, processor number at bit 16 and a valid bit at bit 20. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG0
struct.doc: Scratch register 0. The header names its bit uses for software only and gives a mask of the bits that exist, 0x0000000f00f11fff. The IRIX register table confirms the access. Only the bits in the header's IIO_SCRATCH_MASK, 0x0000000f00f11fff, exist; the rsvd mask is its complement. Established as the header's statement that not all bits are available; whether the missing bits read zero is not stated.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG1
struct.doc: Scratch register 1, the twin of register 0. The IRIX register table confirms the access. Only the bits in the header's IIO_SCRATCH_MASK, 0x0000000f00f11fff, exist; the rsvd mask is its complement. Established as the header's statement that not all bits are available; whether the missing bits read zero is not stated.

struct.name: IIO_ITTE
struct.doc: Big-window translation entry n, for n from 0 to 6. Entry 0 is at the register offset and each later entry is eight bytes further on. The IRIX register table confirms the access.

struct.name: IIO_IIBUSERR
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header: IIO_IIBUSERR (offset and name; the header lists it as 0x1400208 in the local I/O window, which is this offset past the 0x1000000 window base)
struct.doc: Reads here cause a bus error, per the header's comment. The header gives no layout and no reset. The access letter is the comment's reading and is graded inferred.
